name: CME Sunday Reopen Bell
description: When CME crypto futures reopen at 6 pm New York time on Sunday after the weekend, crypto gets much more volatile, but the Kalshi price in that 15-minute window still prices the calm weekend. So the side that's currently losing is more likely to come back than its price says; a few minutes into the window, buy that underdog on ETH, BTC and SOL.
hypothesis: us-hours-vol's 9:30 ET bell mechanism on a weekly clock: the Sunday 18:00 ET CME reopen is a vol step (ETH research: +0.87 log vs month mean) that Kalshi underprices (log iv/rv_fut 0.00 vs 0.23 normally). Losers: favourite buyers and quoting bots using trailing weekend vol. Rule copied unchanged from us-hours-vol (checkpoints 600-240 s, underdog 10-45c, spread <= 6c) on ETH, BTC, SOL fixed in advance. Wrong if the full walk-forward isn't positive or months are mostly negative; sample is ~1 market per coin per week, so a CI > 0 is unlikely even if real.
